text:
Maya: Heads-up — merchant (Frostbyte Labs) still showing overdue for invoice INV-2025-342 for $48,700. Customer attempted a partial card payment yesterday and it declined. Billing portal shows a pending ACH attempt but bank returned R01.

Liam: Thanks Maya. Do we have a recent contact record? Was the card flagged or just insufficient funds?

Maya: Contacted Sophie yesterday — they requested a wire because their card limit is locked due to internal ops. Sophie said they'd initiate wire today but haven't confirmed transmission.

Sophie: I'm on it. I pushed the payment request to our client contacts and asked them to confirm ETA + send remittance. They asked if we can accept a two-part schedule (50/50) with the wire for the first half and a follow-up ACH in 30 days.

Miguel: Two-part sounds okay from a collections POV but we need legal sign-off on schedule + late fee waiver. Also prefer wire first then set up automated reminder for the second installment.

Tara (Legal): I can approve a one-time split schedule if we: 1) add written consent from the client, 2) secure a payment authorization form, and 3) keep standard late fees if second payment misses deadline. Can Sophie collect a signed email thread?

Sophie: I'll get written confirmation and paste it into the ticket. Quick Q: should we accept the wire to our usual account or use fallback account for immediate clearance?

Maya: Their finance team is overseas; wire could take 2-3 business days to clear. We can offer fallback routing to our USD domestic account to speed settlement, but accounting wants a routing confirmation.

accounting-bot: Invoice INV-2025-342 | Status: Overdue (30d) | Balance: $48,700 | Last attempt: ACH R01 returned | Recommended action: Manual outreach + wire fallback accepted by accounting? Please confirm.

Miguel: If they can wire USD to our domestic bank, that mitigates settlement risk. Need to provide the remittance instructions. Important: DO NOT paste full account numbers in public channel — use secure ticket or email to client.

Sophie: Understood. I'll DM the client the secure link to upload remittance proof and request signed split-schedule reply. I'll also create a secure note in the billing ticket with the routing instructions.

Maya: Workflow for internal ops: 1) Sophie collects written consent + remittance proof, 2) Accounting confirms wire receipt and marks invoice partially paid, 3) Legal adds clause to ticket about late-fee reactivation, 4) Collections schedules automated reminder 5 days before second installment.

Tara (Legal): Fine. I'll draft a two-sentence addendum they can approve: "We agree to split payment of INV-2025-342 into two equal installments. Failure to remit the second installment by [date] will reinstate applicable late fees and collection actions." Approve?

Liam: That wording is good. Sophie — please attach the signed email and set the second installment date to 30 days from wire clear date.

Sophie: Will do. I'll update ticket #BILL-4821 with the signed note and DM Mateo (client) our secure upload link.

Maya: Thanks team. If the customer stalls after wire for the remainder, escalate to Legal + Sales for hold on provisioning.

Miguel: Noted. I'll add a 5-day pre-due reminder and a 2-day escalation ping to the POD.
